input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer.
input.rationale: Matches the preferred position on every parameter: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable by an independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and 22.2 expressly bars direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data and privileged material. Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) adds no separate audit burden on us. No redline.

input.quote: Vendor shall continue the Services while a payment dispute is pending and shall not charge interest on an amount ultimately found not due.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty or minimum termination fee is payable by Customer. Section 9.4 gives convenience termination with no early-termination fee, 7.3 protects disputed amounts from interest, and 27.3 allows termination "without penalty". The Section 2.1 take-or-pay is the nearest analogue but is a purchase commitment rather than a liquidated-damages clause and is addressed under MINCOMMIT. No redline for this rule.
